rows.en: All right, charge!
At this rate it's mayonnaise rice again.
Sheesh, you're such a handful.
And you call yourself a pilot? You're such a klutz!
Looks like we got through it somehow.
All right, let's go home!
Good work, everyone!
Keeping up with me? Not bad!
Hmm, not bad for a pilot.
Let's do it again next time!
Come on, let's go home and have tea.
You'll come to my live show when we get back, right?
I never felt like we'd lose.
Gamlin? What's gotten into you?
Protodeviln stuck to Gamlin, get out!
Gamlin!
This is Ray Lovelock, Sound Force. Heading out.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'Sound Horse'; read as Sound Force.

rows.en: Standing by! Let's make today's live show a hit, too!
I was an ace pilot once too. I won't hold you back.
So close.
Make it in time!
The tempo's too slow.
Auto.
rows.notes: Single word 'oto' (auto); low confidence, maybe a mishearing.

rows.en: What?
While I'm at it!
There's more!
How about this one?
Damn it!
That scared me.
Ow!
You're not getting away!
Sorry about that.
All right!
All right, time for a special live show. Let's start!
We've got to make this show a good one.
We'll make sure Fire Bomber's song is heard far and wide!
You're going to hear our song!
You won't get away that easily.
You're going to listen properly!
Time for one big bang!
Listen to my keyboard! Isn't that how it goes?
rows.notes: Parody of Basara's 'Listen to my song'.

rows.en: Listen up!
This feels pretty good!
So, do you still want more?
Hot, isn't it? That's our sound.
There's a knack to flying.
I was an ace pilot, you know.
What a lousy, groove-less tune.
What's going on?!
Here they come!
rows.notes: Last word 'sutaga' unclear; read as ossu/'here they come'.

rows.en: Looks like our VIP guests have arrived.
Looks like I went a little too far.
Hey, hey! Leaving in the middle of the show is bad manners!
Damn! We lost some of the audience!
Uh-oh. The shield's been knocked out.
You took out my shield, huh. Nice going.
rows.notes: Transcript 'shield ga yatte kureru' garbled; read as 'shield o yatte kureru'.

rows.en: Hey, shields aren't free, you know!
You scratched my precious machine!
I can still handle this much.
Damn it, you're paying for the repairs!
We're just getting started.
You're doing whatever you like, aren't you?
I'm losing my touch.
This is a little bad.
Hot!
I can't run away here.
Man, that's rough.
Too strong.
Giving up just isn't my style.
Engine's hit. I can't get any power. Making an emergency landing.
A former ace is just past glory.
Be careful!
You're a bit short of your usual energy.
You'll get yourself killed someday. Seriously.
What, you got shot down?
Getting shot down before me is cheating!
